title: Chhorii 2
desc: Sakshi fights a dangerous cult to save her seven-year-old daughter, battling societal abuses and haunting horrors that trap women, while seeking safety and justice for all.

title: Ghar Ki Laxmi
desc: Suryakant Garodia's obsession for a son leads him to remarry. After finally having a boy, he cruelly neglects his four daughters and their heartbroken mother.

title: Laapataa Ladies
desc: Two newly married brides are accidentally swapped, triggering hilarious misadventures. Each woman navigates unexpected challenges, leading to chaos, laughter, and surprising twists in their new life.

title: Marjaavan
desc: Raghu, a loyal gangster, earns the trust of local don Narayan Anna, becoming his favourite. But envy brews in Narayan's son Vishnu, who plots to bring Raghu down and reclaim his father's attention.

title: Kapatadhaari
desc: Gowtham, a traffic cop with dreams of solving crimes, finds skeletal remains and defies orders to investigate, diving into a mystery beyond his duty.

title: Fast Charlie
desc: A seasoned fixer and hitman, Charlie Swift survives a mob war triggered by a rival boss, then vows revenge to honor his fallen ally, Stan.
